analyst.summary: RBL Bank is a private-sector bank that went through a real credit-cost stress period in late 2024/early 2025 (mirroring a sector-wide unsecured-lending stress cycle) and has since recovered steadily. The most important recent development is a dramatic shift in ownership - a new 60% promoter stake appeared in the June 2026 quarter alongside signs of a large new share issuance - which looks like a major capital-raising or strategic-investor transaction, though we could not confirm the counterparty or terms from available sources. Given this unresolved but potentially significant development, we are holding the stock per house rules while flagging it for management-level verification.
